messages:
maria: Heads up — opened PR #412 to add a short troubleshooting snippet for context-trim detection + lightweight retry guidance. want a quick pair of SDK examples (node + py) and a note for the errref.

sam: saw it, nice. can you paste the snippet mock here so i can eyeball?

maria: sure — thinking minimal: how to check headers for a trim signal and fallback to a shorter system prompt; plus retry handling for transient 429/504 with exponential backoff. example:```js
// node example (fetch)
const res = await fetch(url, {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)});
if (res.status === 429 || res.status === 504) {
  // retry with backoff
}
const trimHint = res.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim');
if (trimHint) {
  // record event, shorten prompt, re-run
}
```

kevin: i can port that to a python requests snippet. also, do we have a canonical header name? x-rw-context-trim okay to use in docs?

maria: it's a docs-only placeholder — we should say "inspect the service metadata header (e.g., x-rw-context-trim)" and call out customers may see different vendor headers. keep it generic.

liz: two quick asks: 1) add a one-liner on when to prefer "trim+retry" vs. "shrink prompt up front" (latency vs. quality tradeoff). 2) link to errref page for 429/timeout semantics.

sam: also add a tiny test harness example — show a synthetic request that triggers trimming so readers can reproduce locally. keeps the snippet actionable.

maria: good call — i'll add a small curl command that simulates a long prompt and show the header in the response:```bash
curl -i -X POST $RW_URL -d @big_prompt.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY"
# expect: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# x-rw-context-trim: true
```

kevin: i'll do the python snippet + unit test example. sam — can you own the node SDK snippet linting? the linter bot flagged some fenced-code-format rules earlier.

sam: yep. i'll run the snippets through the docs linter and the snippets CI.

docs-bot: PR #412 opened by maria — reviewers requested: @sam @kevin; label: docs-snippet, needs-ci.

ci-bot: snippet-lint failed on PR #412: code fence lang mismatch (expected "javascript" not "js"). tests: snippet-lint-1 failing.

maria: argh — i'll fix the fence tags and push. also i'll add the section liz asked for (tradeoffs).

liz: small editorial: call the pattern "detect-and-shorten" in the text so cross-links are consistent with the errref.

maria: ok i'll rename heading to "Detect-and-shorten: handling context trims" and add a one-paragraph flowchart. pushing a new commit in ~20m.

kevin: once thats in i'll open a follow-up to add the python unit test and the reproducible fixture.

sam: after ci passes i'll do a quick review. should be small (snippets + one paragraph).

maria: thanks all :heart: — tagging @liz for final editorial before merge.

liz: will do a copyedit after the CI green.
